item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
What this policy covers

This policy explains what personal information [[PLACEHOLDER: verified legal entity name]] collects through this website, why it is collected, how it is stored and who to contact about it. It applies to the enquiry form on the About and Gallery pages and to any email or phone contact made through this site.

Who is accountable

The entity accountable for personal information collected through this site is [[PLACEHOLDER: verified legal entity name]], ABN [[PLACEHOLDER: verified ABN]], trading as [[PLACEHOLDER: verified trading name]].

What is collected

The enquiry form collects your name, phone number, suburb, the service you are asking about and, optionally, your email address, an approximate job size and a free-text message. Nothing else is collected through the form. The site does not collect payment details.

Why it is collected

To respond to your enquiry, to quote on the work you have asked about, and to contact you about that enquiry. It is not used for anything else, and it is not sold, rented or disclosed to third parties for marketing.

Where it goes

Form submissions are delivered by email to [[PLACEHOLDER: verified recipient address]] and are stored in the website database. Delivery is by authenticated SMTP through [[PLACEHOLDER: verified sending domain]].

How long it is kept

Enquiry records are kept for [[PLACEHOLDER: owner-decided retention period]] and then deleted. If your enquiry becomes a quoted or completed job, the record is kept for as long as required for tax and warranty purposes.

Consent

The enquiry form asks you to tick a box confirming you agree to be contacted about your enquiry and to your details being stored for that purpose. The box is not ticked for you. You can withdraw consent at any time using the contact details below.

Access, correction and complaints

You can ask what personal information is held about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted. Contact [[PLACEHOLDER: verified contact address for privacy requests]] or call [[PLACEHOLDER: verified phone number]]. We will respond within a reasonable period.

If you are not satisfied with how a request was handled, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.

Cookies and analytics

[[VERIFY: confirm which analytics or tracking scripts are installed before publication. If any are present this section must describe them; if none are present it must say so.]]

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the revised version is published on this page with a new effective date.

Effective date: [[PLACEHOLDER: date of publication]]
